name: proton-pass
description: Audited Proton Pass access for AI agents via the official pass-cli and a scoped agent token (never your personal session). Search items, list field names, and run commands with pass:// secrets resolved only inside the child process. Every call records a mandatory reason, which you can review with `pass-cli agent monitor`.

PROTON_PASS_AGENT_TOKEN.description: Proton Pass agent token from `pass-cli agent create <name> --expiration 1m --vault <Vault>` (pst_...::...). Never your account password.

PROTON_PASS_AGENT_TOKEN_FILE.description: Optional path to a 0600 file containing the agent token. Default: ~/.config/proton-pass-agent/token.
